rationale: Trip Delay under section 3 of the wording needs "the carrier's confirmation of the delay and its cause", and manual section 5 lists that as a required document. The Northwind certificate confirms the times (08:15 to 17:32, so the First plan's 3-hour waiting period is met) but says nothing about the cause. The claim appears payable at $61 (breakfast $27 + lunch $34, reasonable meal receipts, no deductible and well under the $1,500 maximum), so a claims handler should send a 30-day document request for the carrier's written confirmation of the cause of the delay and approve once it arrives.
